aarti.tek: Victory to you, Bābā Gaṅgārām; victory to you, Gaṅgārām. You are the remover of suffering, the giver of good fortune and the abode of every happiness.
aarti.pad1: Whoever meditates with a true heart, you accomplish his work; he gains wealth and prosperity and every happiness, as the whole world knows. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: At dawn we worship you, taking your name; we offer you sandal paste and flowers, and bow to you. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: You cut away the disease and grief of all; you dwell in your abode at Jhunjhunu. Whoever comes to the temple for your darśana will gain happiness and children. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: You dwell in the world of the gods and are great throughout the world; whoever remembers you, good surely comes to him. ॥4॥
aarti.pad5: Whoever keeps faith and devotion in his heart and meditates on you, protect him always; you are the abode of compassion. ॥5॥
aarti.pad6: Bābā, we are your children; we have no knowledge at all. With joined hands we pray to you; we are simple and unknowing. ॥6॥
aarti.pad7: Giver of happiness and wealth, always do good. Forgive our faults; you are a god of great might. ॥7॥
